blocks.orig: Tukaone Weavers Serengeti Camp is a family-owned retreat in Central Serengeti, a short distance from the Seronera Airstrip. It features 15 spacious en-suite safari tents raised on timber platforms, complete with private verandahs for uninterrupted savanna views. The tents come in twin, double, or triple setups and feature hot solar-heated showers, mosquito nets, and shelves for convenience. You can gather in the central lounge and dining tent for freshly prepared local and international meals made from locally sourced ingredients, or relax on the verandah as the sun dips below the plains. With Wi-Fi and its eco-friendly design, the camp combines comfort with an authentic safari atmosphere. The camp offers easy access to the Seronera River Valley – known for rich wildlife sightings.
blocks.html: A short distance from the Seronera Airstrip, Tukaone Weavers Serengeti Camp is a family-owned retreat in Central Serengeti. It has 15 spacious en-suite safari tents on raised timber platforms, each with a private verandah offering uninterrupted views over the savanna. You can choose a twin, double or triple layout, and every tent has hot solar-heated showers, mosquito nets and handy shelves. In the central lounge and dining tent you come together for freshly prepared local and international dishes made with local ingredients, or you relax on your verandah while the sun sets over the plains. Thanks to its Wi-Fi and eco-friendly design, the camp blends comfort with a genuine safari feel. The Seronera River Valley is easy to reach from the camp – an area known for its rich wildlife sightings.
